name: Pure Silver Core: Deceit
descriptionTemplate: At the start of the battle, {Rouse} all Awakeners, place {Twilight: Honey Mead} into hand, and increase all Awakeners' Crit. DMG to 1.5 times. At turn end, Awakeners that did not release Exalt gain [Arg1] Aliemus. If the number of cards played is less than [Arg2], draw 2 cards next turn and gain 2 Arithmetica.
